## How to connect

- **CNA Discussions**; ask questions, share ideas, and help each other: [github.com/m-baum/CNA/discussions](https://github.com/m-baum/CNA/discussions), in categories *General · Help &amp; Support · Ideas · Announcements*.
- **All Things Configured**; the CNA community of practice and mailing list: [join here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_vZjj4cJw9uyhGtyl8hLRimkV8PFaTFIv2QrrJL8oIgLt3g/viewform).
